chunks: And Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The mukātab inherits and is inherited from according to the proportion of what he has paid.

key_terms.اَلْمُكَاتَبُ: A slave under a manumission contract who earns freedom through agreed payments.
key_terms.عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا أَدَّى: In proportion to the amount he has already paid toward his freedom.

ai.seo_question: How does a mukātab inherit in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the inheritance status of a mukātab, a slave under a contract for freedom. His right to inherit and the estate inherited from him are determined in proportion to the amount of his contractual payment that he has completed.
